title: payout.requested v1
description: Published by payroll through its outbox to stream:payout.requested; consumed by payout-worker (group payout-worker). Carries IDs and the amount only: no names, no bank details. The worker must use the amount from GET /v1/internal/payouts/{payout_id}/instruction, never this one; a mismatch is poison. The bank idempotency key is <payout_id>:<attempt>. Each re-publish of the same attempt has a fresh event_id and a higher republish_seq. Sources: plan §7, PAY-402, ADR 0003.

event_id.description: UUIDv7, unique per publication (including each re-publish). Equals payroll.outbox.id.

occurred_at.description: UTC time the outbox row was written, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of the publishing span; the consumer starts its processing span as a child of it.

company_id.description: The tenant. The worker puts it in its JWT cid claim when calling payroll.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number (at most PAYOUT_MAX_ATTEMPTS, 5 by default, including the first).

amount_cents.description: Net pay in integer cents. Zero-net payouts are no_transfer and are never published. Capped at $10M (ADR 0006).

republish_seq.description: 0 for the first publication of an attempt (approve or retry); k for its k-th re-publish by payroll maintenance (PAY-407).
